title: ReMAP: Lossless Residual Neural Lifting for Scalable MAP Inference in Arbitrary-Order Markov Random Fields
abstract: arXiv:2411.18954v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Maximum a posteriori inference in a finite Markov random field is generally NP-hard. We study an instance-wise optimizer that minimizes the exact multilinear energy under product marginals. The canonical parameterization adds a GNN output to free per-node logits. This residual bypass is a global change of coordinates, so the lifting preserves the infimum, critical points, local extrema (modulo the GNN-parameter fiber), and Hessian inertia of the free-logit problem. Joint gradient flow then induces the preconditioner $I+JJ^{\top}$: the GNN cannot enlarge the feasible set, but it can add dissipation $\|J^{\top}\nabla\ell\|_{2}^{2}$. For a two-layer branch this extra coupling is four-hop local. We also show that every finite critical point of a nonconstant multilinear objective is a saddle, and that a unique MAP gap $\Gamma$ makes conditional-expectation rounding exact once the relaxed gap falls below $\Gamma$; residual gradient f

translated_title: ReMAP：用于任意阶马尔可夫随机场可扩展MAP推理的无损残差神经提升方法
translated_abstract: 有限马尔可夫随机场中的最大后验（MAP）推理通常是NP难问题。我们研究了一种实例级优化器，其在乘积边缘分布下最小化精确的多线性能量。该规范参数化将图神经网络（GNN）的输出添加到自由的每节点logits上。这种残差旁路是一种全局坐标变换，因此该提升方法能够保持自由logit问题的下确界、临界点、局部极值（模去GNN参数纤维）以及Hessian惯性。联合梯度流进而诱导出预条件子 $I+JJ^{\top}$：GNN无法扩大可行集，但可以增加耗散项 $\|J^{\top}\nabla\ell\|_{2}^{2}$。对于两层分支结构，这种额外的耦合是四跳局部的。我们还证明了非常数多线性目标的每个有限临界点都是鞍点，并且存在一个唯一的MAP间隙 $\Gamma$，使得一旦松弛间隙降至 $\Gamma$ 以下，条件期望舍入即为精确解；残差梯度……
tldr: 提出ReMAP方法，通过将GNN输出作为残差旁路叠加到自由logits上实现无损坐标变换，在严格保持原问题临界点、局部极值和Hessian惯性的同时，实现了任意阶马尔可夫随场中可扩展的精确MAP推理。
en_tdlr: ReMAP introduces a lossless residual neural lifting that adds GNN outputs as a bypass to free logits, strictly preserving critical points, local extrema, and Hessian inertia of the original problem, thereby enabling scalable exact MAP inference in arbitrary-order Markov random fields.
